# device42_subnet_category (Resource)


## Exemple

```hcl
resource "device42_subnet_category" "myNewSubnetCategory" {
   name        = "myNewSubnetCategory"
   description = "My new subnet category"
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the subnet category. Create only.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the subnet category.
- `groups` (String) Comma separated list of groups associated with the subnet category.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
